mostWorthwhile.text: Following the grazing impact into a moon was most worthwhile: the same world survived while orbiting debris gathered into a companion.

leastWorthwhile.text: The later fragment path felt somewhat repetitive, with rubble collecting material and then breaking apart again.

surprise.text: I expected the coated rubble might add to the crossing body, but the encounter broke some of it apart instead.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely purposeless, though the repeated fragment encounters were largely guided by the only offered combination rather than a choice I understood in advance.

continue.text: I would continue, mainly to see what becomes of the world and moon, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the largely linear fragment sequence.
